design: Five paired deterministic seeds, 1,400 synthetic stationary observations then reversed causal reward contingencies over postchange budgets 28,56,140,280,560. Compare unchanged counts vs first-eight-then-every-fourth lossy sampling. Snapshot/restore each run in a distinct Python process.
interpretation: Neither baseline nor sparse learner adapts effectively after the synthetic contingency reversal, so equal poor adaptation is not evidence of successful retention or plasticity. No original-world science or 2x improvement.
limitations: cold restore proves reproducibility rather than generalization
next_gate: RAR-G12 investigate bounded belief revision or recency-weighted update with stationary-retention controls, under exact pinned source and synthetic-only preregistration.
